findings.evidence: Paper prints b=.571 with 95% CI (-.544,.032). The interval does not contain .571 and is identical to the Self-Esteem CI of the Manipulation Check model in Table 2 (line 223). Stored output (results/main.html, confint(m6)) gives (.412,.731).
